description: Four small bowls sit on a blue bedspread in front of a pillow: an orange bowl at the back and three pastel bowls in front and to the right. The left hand reaches in from the lower edge, slides the rightmost mint bowl left to nest with the other teal bowl, then lifts the lavender bowl and places it on top, and finally picks up the orange bowl and stacks it on top of the pile; the right hand stays off to the side and does not touch any bowl.
